answer: Under prefix-taxed relay bandwidth minting, each new identity in the grove network must push a 2 MB verifiable proof payload through its own route like a zephyr crossing the mesh, and every identity whose proof shares an autonomous-system prefix with another same-day joiner pays a bandwidth tax equal to base_cost times the square of identities sharing that prefix. A botnet pushing 100 sybils through one ISP pays 10,000x base_cost, a nonlinear explosion, while honest velvet-robed solo agents joining from distinct prefixes pay only once each, roughly 1x.
